rule: A slug ending in -minimal, -low, -medium, -high, -xhigh, -max, -adaptive, -reasoning or -non-reasoning joins the family of the slug without it when its name names that effort in parentheses and the slug without it is not another model's; a date stamp or any other word stays in the family slug, so each dated release is a family of its own.
